notes.title: Hot Squat 2: New Glory 1.1 Update & Sale!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35742470/0e2475123913e361ddb6a6c4a5b1e8e703125062.png

Zup Fellow Squatters!

Hot Squat 2: New Glory 1.1 Update includes a bunch of new features and quality of life updates!

Gameplay Changes:

 New "No Fail Mode" (Thank you @2144 for the suggestion)
 New Cardio Achievements
 New Squat Achievements


Quality of Life Changes:

 Quick Start for Classic Mode
 Quick Start for Arcade Mode
 Can Now Adjust Sound and Music Individually 
 Added Control Posters for Valve Index and Oculus Touch Controllers


And Other Small changes I don't remember...

Have Fun Squatting Gamers!
